children.text: Hi ${data.user_name}! 👋 Roommates NG matches you with a compatible roommate in your area.

*How it works*
We search for a compatible roommate and notify you here on WhatsApp. When you accept a match, you pay a one-time *₦2,000* fee to unlock your roommate's contact details.

⚠️ *Scam warning:* We never ask for rent or deposits on this chat. Only pay the ₦2,000 unlock fee through the official Paystack link we send you, and always inspect an apartment and verify ownership before paying any landlord or agent.
